decisions.reason: The source decision concerns the LinkedIn outbound campaign; it does not necessarily change the separate email campaign, whose automation mode and MeetAlfred platform already remain unchanged.
Choosing automated MeetAlfred execution for the LinkedIn campaign does not change how CRM lead lists are synchronized to MeetAlfred.
The source selects campaign automation and a preferred platform but does not alter the established workflow for creating and provisioning a MeetAlfred campaign.
Using MeetAlfred for an automated outbound campaign neither cancels nor changes the independent constraint to preserve existing campaigns.
The source expresses a platform preference but does not change the required MeetAlfred account plan or account-setup state.
The source does not address silent-lead selection, follow-up list handling, list transfer, or cleanup of prior campaigns.
The MeetAlfred campaign decision does not change the separate Sales Navigator-to-Apollo contact export behavior.
The source does not modify the requirement to connect the campaign email account to MeetAlfred.
The campaign automation preference does not change Zapier account setup, subscription tier, or add-ons.
The source decision has no effect on which type of LinkedIn profile URL is stored in the CRM.
Automating a LinkedIn campaign through MeetAlfred does not resolve or change how CRM membership or duplicates are shown from LinkedIn.
The source does not modify the separate task of setting up a LinkedIn lead list in Sales Navigator.
